added.summary: A directory's import settings: assets/<dir>/import.ogt, a type import document of match "<pattern>" { … } blocks, gives every file under the directory that a pattern names what a settings file of its own (<file>.ogt) would. A file takes the matching blocks from assets/ down to its own directory, then its own settings file, a later entry replacing an earlier one key by key and two blocks of one key joining. The cooked bytes are those of the same settings written per file; an edit recooks only the files whose settings it changes. Before, a directory of files with the same settings needed one identical settings file each, and an import.ogt was an error.
